hero.subtitle: For over {years} years, HighEnd Restoration has been helping South Florida families recover from water damage, fire, mold, and other disasters.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: HighEnd Restoration started with a simple mission: to help our neighbors when disaster strikes. What began as a small family operation has grown into one of South Florida's most trusted restoration companies.
story.p2: Over the past {years} years, we've helped thousands of families and businesses recover from water damage, fires, mold infestations, and other emergencies. We understand that these situations are stressful, and we're here to make the restoration process as smooth as possible.
story.p3: Today, we continue to operate with the same family values that started it all: honesty, hard work, and genuine care for our community. When you call HighEnd Restoration, you're not just getting a contractor—you're getting a team that truly cares about restoring your property and your peace of mind.

waterDamage.name: Water Damage Restoration
waterDamage.description: Fast, professional water extraction and drying services to protect your property from further damage. We respond 24/7 to flooding emergencies.

step1.title: Emergency Contact
step1.description: Call us anytime, day or night. We typically arrive within 1-2 hours.

step2.title: Assessment & Inspection
step2.description: We assess the damage, identify the water source, and create a restoration plan.

step3.title: Water Extraction & Drying
step3.description: Using industrial equipment, we remove water and thoroughly dry the affected areas.

step4.title: Restoration & Monitoring
step4.description: We restore your property and monitor moisture levels to prevent mold growth.

q1.question: How quickly can you respond to a water emergency?
q1.answer: We offer 24/7 emergency services and typically arrive within 1-2 hours of your call.

q2.question: Do you work with insurance companies?
q2.answer: Yes, we work directly with all major insurance companies and can help with the claims process.

fireRestoration.name: Fire Restoration
fireRestoration.description: Complete fire damage restoration including smoke removal, structural repair, and content cleaning. We help you rebuild after the devastation.

step1.title: Emergency Response
step1.description: We secure your property with board-up services and assess the fire damage.

step2.title: Damage Assessment
step2.description: Our team documents all damage for insurance and creates a detailed restoration plan.

step3.title: Cleanup & Restoration
step3.description: We remove debris, clean surfaces, and eliminate smoke odors throughout the property.

step4.title: Final Restoration
step4.description: We restore your property to its pre-fire condition, including any necessary repairs.

q1.question: Can you remove smoke smell from my home?
q1.answer: Yes, we use specialized equipment and techniques to completely eliminate smoke odors.

q2.question: How long does fire restoration take?
q2.answer: It depends on the extent of damage, but most projects take 2-6 weeks to complete.

moldRestoration.name: Mold Restoration
moldRestoration.description: Professional mold remediation services to protect your family's health. We safely remove mold and address the source to prevent recurrence.

step1.title: Inspection & Assessment
step1.description: We inspect your property, identify mold growth, and determine the moisture source.

step2.title: Containment
step2.description: We isolate affected areas to prevent mold spores from spreading during removal.

step3.title: Removal & Treatment
step3.description: Using HEPA filtration and antimicrobial treatments, we safely remove all mold.

step4.title: Restoration & Prevention
step4.description: We restore affected areas and provide recommendations to prevent future growth.

q1.question: Is mold dangerous to my health?
q1.answer: Yes, mold can cause respiratory issues and allergic reactions. Professional removal is recommended.

q2.question: Will the mold come back after removal?
q2.answer: Not if we address the moisture source. We identify and help fix the underlying cause.

moistureInspection.name: Moisture & Mold Inspection
moistureInspection.description: Comprehensive moisture and mold inspections using advanced detection equipment. Early detection prevents costly damage and health risks.

step1.title: Visual Inspection
step1.description: We thoroughly examine your property for visible signs of moisture damage or mold.

step2.title: Advanced Detection
step2.description: Using thermal cameras and moisture meters, we identify hidden water and mold.

step3.title: Air Quality Testing
step3.description: We test indoor air quality to detect mold spores and assess contamination levels.

step4.title: Detailed Report
step4.description: You receive a comprehensive report with findings and recommended next steps.

q1.question: How do you find hidden mold?
q1.answer: We use thermal imaging and moisture meters to detect mold behind walls and under floors.

q2.question: Should I get an inspection before buying a home?
q2.answer: Yes, a moisture and mold inspection can reveal hidden issues before you purchase.

smokeOdor.name: Smoke & Odor Removal
smokeOdor.description: Professional smoke and odor elimination services. We don't mask odors—we eliminate them at the source using advanced techniques.

step1.title: Odor Assessment
step1.description: We identify the source and extent of smoke or odor contamination.

step2.title: Source Treatment
step2.description: We treat the source of odors with specialized cleaning agents and techniques.

step3.title: Air Treatment
step3.description: Using ozone generators and air scrubbers, we purify the air throughout your property.

step4.title: Verification
step4.description: We verify complete odor elimination and ensure your satisfaction.

q1.question: Can you remove cigarette smoke smell from a home?
q1.answer: Yes, we specialize in removing all types of smoke odors, including years of cigarette smoke.

q2.question: How long does odor removal take?
q2.answer: Most projects are completed within 1-3 days, depending on the severity.

decontamination.name: Decontamination
decontamination.description: Professional biohazard cleanup and decontamination services. We handle hazardous materials safely and restore your property to a safe condition.

step1.title: Initial Assessment
step1.description: We assess the situation and develop a safe cleanup and disposal plan.

step2.title: Containment & Safety
step2.description: We establish containment and use proper PPE to ensure safe handling.

step3.title: Removal & Disinfection
step3.description: We remove all hazardous materials and thoroughly disinfect all surfaces.

step4.title: Verification & Restoration
step4.description: We verify the area is safe and restore it to a clean, livable condition.

q1.question: What types of biohazards do you handle?
q1.answer: We handle blood, bodily fluids, trauma scenes, hoarding situations, and other biohazards.

q2.question: Is this service confidential?
q2.answer: Yes, we maintain complete confidentiality and use unmarked vehicles when requested.
